name: yearmon
title: An Index Class for Monthly Data

origin.description: Snap a numeric year fraction onto month boundaries.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector interpreted as a year plus a fraction of a year.

origin.details: yearmon stores the year plus 0 for January, 1/12 for February, 2/12 for March, and so on, the same encoding as a monthly ts. The stored value is floor(12 * x + 0.0001) / 12.
origin.value: A numeric vector of class yearmon.
origin.example:
x <- yearmon(2000 + (0:11)/12)
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
cat(paste(format(x), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Snap a numeric year fraction onto month boundaries.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A number or a sequence of numbers, read as a year plus a fraction of a year.

translation.details: The result is a Yearmon. Its value array is floor(12 * x + 0.0001) / 12 in float64, so January of 2000 is 2000 and March is 2000 + 2/12. Missing values stay missing.
translation.value: A Yearmon whose value array is the snapped year fraction.
translation.example:
from zoo.yearmon import format_yearmon, yearmon
import numpy as np
x = yearmon(2000 + np.arange(12) / 12)
print(" ".join(format(v, ".17g") for v in x.value))
print(" ".join(format_yearmon(x)))
